### Conversion parameters

:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--layers_mapping`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Mapping of Seurat's Layers to AnnData layers.
If True, all layers will be mapped by name.
If False, no layers will be mapped.
For custom mapping, provide a json key/value array with Seurat fields as values and AnnData fields as keys.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"True"`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"{\"layer\": \"seurat_layer\"}"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--obs_mapping`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Mapping of Seurat's observation columns to AnnData obs columns.
If True, all observation columns will be mapped by name. If False, no columns will be mapped.
For custom mapping, provide a json key/value array with Seurat fields as values and AnnData fields as keys.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"True"`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"{\"obs_field\": \"seurat_observation\"}"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--var_mapping`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Mapping of Seurat's feature rows to AnnData var columns.
If True, all features will be mapped by name. If False, no features will be mapped.
For custom mapping, provide a json key/value array with Seurat fields as values and AnnData fields as keys.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"True"`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"{\"var_field\": \"seurat_feature\"}"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--uns_mapping`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Mapping of Seurat's Misc to AnnData uns.
If True, all fields will be mapped by name. If False, no fields will be mapped.
For custom mapping, provide a json key/value array with Seurat fields as values and AnnData fields as keys.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"True"`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"{\"uns_field\": \"seurat_Misc\"}"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--obsm_mapping`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}

`string`

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/convert/from_seurat_to_h5mu/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/convert/from_seurat_to_h5mu);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/convert/from_seurat_to_h5mu/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
